{{Top|leg}}
'''Free-palm leaf''' was a type of large [[Plant/Legends|plant]] leaf found on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. After the defeat of the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>, [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] served [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]], [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]], an Imperial [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] [[Scout trooper armor/Legends|helmet]] lined with a free-palm leaf and filled with sweet [[Berry/Legends|berry]] [[Fruit juice/Legends|juice]] that he had picked and blended himself in the home that he made from the ruins of the [[Endor shield generator bunker|Imperial shield generator bunker]].<ref name="GG5">''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Free-palm leaf was only mentioned in the first edition of ''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]'',<ref name="GG5" /> but the mention was omitted in the the [[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|second edition]].<ref name="GG5 second">[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi'' Second Edition]]</ref>
